levels.title: Aura Farmer
story: The boss of aura maxing waits, perfectly still.

opponent.name: THE BOAT KID
opponent.persona: An archetype, the boss of aura maxing: kid sized, black traditional outfit, sunglasses, a serious face. Silence and calm, the boat arm sweep.

levels.title: Turnstile Sigma
story: Hands in pockets, he never paid a ticket.

opponent.name: THE TURNSTILE NINJA
opponent.persona: Silent, cocky, hands in pockets, chin up. Never paid a metro ticket.

levels.title: Grumpy Legend
story: Papi hates your music and your haircut.

opponent.name: PAPI RALEUR
opponent.persona: A grumpy grandpa who complains about everything, then dances better than you.

levels.title: Rive Gauche
story: She judged your outfit before the beat.

opponent.name: LA PARISIENNE
opponent.persona: Effortless, unimpressed, a coffee in hand, judges everyone in silence.

levels.title: Granny Gains
story: She runs marathons and still out grooves you.

opponent.name: SPORTY GRANNY
opponent.persona: Tracksuit, sweatband, 80 years of cardio, zero mercy.
